Candidate source register

Week 1 university courses

Coverage, accessibility, advantages, limits, and actual review level are kept separate.

What the register means

A course page and its chapter match were checked before entry. A syllabus match does not count as having read the lecture text. The chapter's own source audit determines which four or more university texts were genuinely compared and synthesized.

Course selection is chapter-specific: coverage of that chapter, mathematical precision, proof quality, and accessible written material matter more than university prestige alone.
